2974.title: Embedded composer loses selected provider provenance
2974.rootCauseOneLine: The component-local provenance builder omits the selected provider source before the exported composer returns its request.
2974.proposedFix: Add explicit provider provenance in the exported plugin composer before it calls the plugin callback.
2974.caveats: The reproduction uses the real component path with mocked data queries. It does not start a provider process.
